description: Reduce / clean a graph: Longest Branch · Prune Spurs · Dissolve · Min Spanning Tree · Largest Component · Keep Loops / Bridges · Keep Outer Boundary / Inner Segments.
instructions:
Cleans / reduces an incoming graph (polylines) by one algorithm (`mode`), all outputting a single graph:
• longest-branch — the path between the two farthest tips.
• prune — remove leaf branches shorter than `minLength` (m); `iterate` = prune to stable.
• dissolve — merge degree-2 chains, snapping junctions within `mergeTol` (m) first.
• mst — minimum spanning tree · largest — largest connected component · loops / bridges — keep only cycle / bridge edges · outer / inner — keep the outer boundary / inner segments.

Min branch length is wireable.
